name: Temple and Cemetery of Confucius and the Kong Family Mansion in Qufu
description: In Qufu, Shandong Province, three linked sites honour Confucius, the philosopher born here more than 2,500 years ago. His temple, first built in 478 B.C., now spreads across more than 100 buildings. A short distance away, his family's mansion keeps 152 buildings, and the forested cemetery holds his tomb along with over 100,000 descendants' graves.
